news.title: Augustana Expands Government & International Affairs Department With Four Specialized Majors
news.summary_en: In Fall 2026, the Augustana UniversityGovernment & International Affairs Departmentexpanded its degree program offerings to include more specialized majors — giving students focused pathways aligned with their interests, workforce demands and graduate school preparation.

news.title: Theatre Department Presents 'Straw Boy,' World Premier by Augustana Alumna
news.summary_en: The Augustana UniversityTheatre Departmentpresents the world premier ofStraw Boyby Mikennah Oleson '26.Straw Boy,presented on Oct. 22-25, is a reimagining ofPinocchioand aims to spin an almost-fairy tale — filled with music and magic, as well as questions of what it means to be real and good.
